topic_summary: Analysis of a space station crew managing accelerating semantic drift across three functionally separated languages (Technical Tagalog, Institutional English, Bahay-Tagalog). The narrative examines how lexical innovation outpaces institutional translation capacity, creating operational failures until crews implement collective documentation as a coordination mechanism.

key_entities: Technical Tagalog (operational creole evolving at 9 new terms/week)
Institutional English (frozen administrative language from 2061 founding)
Supervisors (translation bridge role, exemplified by Rafael)
Earth-side management (institutional authority, unaware of drift severity)
key_tensions: Lexical innovation velocity vs translation capacity (9 terms/week vs supervisor bandwidth)
Operational precision needs vs institutional vocabulary adequacy (pagkasira ng tinig vs 'signal degradation')
Collective coordination needs vs individual translation labor burden (distributed glossary vs Rafael's exhaustion)

axes.human_readable: Semantic Drift Velocity (Innovation Rate vs Stabilization Capacity)
axes.structural_delta: Rate of lexical innovation exceeds institutional capacity to stabilize meaning, creating expanding semantic gap between operational and administrative vocabularies
axes.primary_observable: New term introduction rate (terms/week); mistranslation incident frequency; translation time per report
axes.selection_reason: Upstream mountain providing physical constraint base; irreducible velocity differential driving all downstream dynamics

axes.structural_delta: Individual coordinator role required to maintain semantic bridge between diverging vocabularies becomes cognitively unsustainable as drift accelerates
axes.primary_observable: Supervisor translation time per shift; recognition lag for new terms; self-reported cognitive load; bridge role turnover rate
axes.selection_reason: Downstream synthesis node with distinct beneficiary structure; captures extraction dynamic where institutional authority externalizes coordination costs onto bridge role

axes.human_readable: Collective Documentation as Coordination Mechanism (Distributed Stabilization)
axes.structural_delta: Shift from individual translation labor to collective documentation protocol redistributes semantic stabilization work across community, creating negotiated equilibrium between innovation and coordination
axes.primary_observable: Glossary update frequency; contributor distribution; mistranslation incident rate pre/post implementation; crew confidence metrics
axes.selection_reason: Highest centrality; downstream synthesis node capturing intervention that transforms constraint topology from individual extraction to collective maintenance

axes.structural_delta: Three languages maintained in deliberate functional separation (operational/administrative/intimacy) rather than converging into single creole
axes.primary_observable: Code-switching patterns by context; vocabulary overlap between languages; language choice by social function
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: structural precondition for drift but lower independent yield than selected upstream axis; captured implicitly in semantic_drift_velocity mountain

axes.human_readable: Competence Hierarchy Emergence (Fluency as Social Stratification)
axes.structural_delta: Differential fluency in rapidly evolving operational vocabulary creates informal competence hierarchy, with newer members compensating through formal language use that increases social distance
axes.primary_observable: Technical Tagalog fluency by contract length; English overuse by new crew; self-reported competence anxiety; social integration metrics
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: downstream social consequence of drift but structurally parallel to translation_labor_exhaustion rather than causally linked; lower centrality

axes.structural_delta: Administrative vocabulary frozen at system founding (2061) lacks terms for operational realities discovered later (2075+), forcing parallel vocabulary development
axes.primary_observable: Manual term coverage of operational phenomena; age of institutional vocabulary vs domain knowledge; translation precision loss rate
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: structural precondition but captured by semantic_drift_velocity mountain; piton classification indicates atrophied coordination rather than independent dynamic

omegas.description: Does collective documentation eventually ossify into institutional control? The narrative shows Earth-side quietly adopting the practice—does this transform the scaffold into a new snare where institutional authority captures the coordination mechanism?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) applied to collective_documentation_coordination scaffold

omegas.description: Is semantic drift velocity truly a mountain (physics of distributed innovation) or a rope (coordination failure)? The glossary reduces mistranslations but drift continues at 9 terms/week—does this indicate irreducible innovation rate or inadequate stabilization mechanism?
omegas.source: F03 (Hasty Generalization) check on semantic_drift_velocity mountain classification

omegas.description: Is the bridge role structurally necessary or an artifact of institutional design? The narrative shows Rafael's exhaustion but doesn't examine whether direct crew-to-Earth communication could eliminate the translation layer entirely.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory)—alternative coordination topologies not explored

omegas.description: What role does Bahay-Tagalog (intimacy language) play in the coordination system? The narrative treats it as background but doesn't examine whether emotional/social coordination enables operational coordination.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory)—third language treated as figure/ground rather than structural element

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: semantic_drift_velocity classified as mountain (irreducible innovation rate) but narrative evidence suggests it may be rope (coordination failure). The glossary intervention reduces mistranslations without reducing drift velocity, which could indicate either (a) mountain correctly classified—innovation is irreducible, coordination just manages it better, or (b) rope misclassified as mountain—drift velocity is coordination-dependent and glossary only partially addresses it. Generated omega_drift_equilibrium to bound this uncertainty. No other fractures detected—multi-lens scan applied (sociolinguistics, organizational communication, coordination theory), dark matter probes surfaced absence of alternative coordination topologies and intimacy language function.
